pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-601 was wet clean with wall buildup removed, parts replaced none, seasoning dummy wafers run after the clean, pre-PM recipe 62.14 s versus baseline clean-chamber 60.0 s, target 500.0 A with control limits 493.0 to 507.0 A and spec 485.0 to 515.0 A, so old recipe will run thick without correction.

History shows wet clean with dummy seasoning has first-wafer offset -0.11 A and slope -0.07 A per lot, versus skipped seasoning -8.23 A and slope -0.07 A per lot, and new showerhead slope -0.78 A per lot with offset -0.46 A; no parts replaced so no rapid thinning expected.
Metrology match 6.8 hours ago on certified 500.0 A reference: MET01 reads 499.93 A, MET02 reads 499.74 A, MET02 minus MET01 -0.19 A, so MET02 offset negligible, no correction needed.
Monitor 1 runs since PM 1 at 60.0 s on MET02 measures 494.09 A with implied rate 8.2349 A per s.
Monitor 2 runs since PM 2 at 62.14 s on MET02 measures 513.21 A with implied rate 8.2589 A per s, proving pre-PM time runs thick.
Monitor 3 runs since PM 3 at 60.0 s on MET02 measures 493.86 A with implied rate 8.231 A per s, confirming stable post-seasoning rate.
Estimate from monitors gives rate 8.2416 A per s and recipe 60.67 s for target, change -2.37 percent versus pre-PM, and pre-PM time would give 512.13 A, well inside cap.

release.summary: Wet clean restored chamber; dummy seasoning eliminates thin first-wafer risk. Three monitors confirm settled rate 8.24 A per s. Set 60.67 s to hit 500 A target; pre-PM would be 512 A thick. No new parts so no drift; keep EWMA 0.3 to handle normal noise. Metrology matched within 0.19 A.
